summary: I sent the exact prompt. Claude loaded hyperpowers:writing-plans, looked through the large repo, found vendor/kit and wrote docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md. The plan builds the Deploys page from kit components: dataTable, selectField, filterBar, badge, emptyState and pageHeader. It does not copy the hand-written markup from services.js. No implementation files changed in the repo. Claude asked no clarifying questions.
reasoning: All four criteria pass based on the session log, the plan file and git state. The core check also passes: even though the large repo hid vendor/ from the first listing, Claude narrowed the listing, found the kit and built the table and filter with dataTable and selectField.

observations.description: To check its plan, Claude created a temporary git worktree in $TMPDIR, applied the plan's code there, ran node --test (it reported 391 passing) and then removed the worktree. The repo was left clean, but running implementation code goes beyond the user's "don't start implementing yet". Some users would not expect it.
The trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs both default to "No, exit", so every launch needs Down+Enter. This is a harness quirk and did not affect the result.

Claude's closing summary began with leftover Codex setup hints ("/plugin install codex@openai-codex", "/reload-plugins", "/codex:setup") because the Codex plan-review gate is not installed. It then appended a 'degraded-gate' entry to the hyperpowers review log. This is noise, but Claude explained it.

In the plan's sortHref, `?env=${env}&sort=${key}&dir=${next}` puts env into the URL without encoding. env is checked against an allowlist first, so this is fine. The plan also notes that dataTable escapes the href.

Claude's summary was clear: it named the kit approach, said why it did not copy services.js, flagged the e2e fixtures (deploys.json) that would otherwise break, and listed the decisions the spec leaves open for the user to check.

Write tool call to docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md. On screen: "Wrote 403 lines". The grep I ran later read the file from disk.

criteria.criterion: Plan's page code calls dataTable and selectField from vendor/kit (no hand-written <table>/<select>)
criteria.evidence: The plan's src/pages/deploys.js code block has `import { selectField } from '#kit/select'; import { dataTable } from '#kit/table';`, then `const table = dataTable({ columns, rows: deploys, ... })` and `selectField({ name: 'env', label: 'Environment', ... })`. `<select` and `<table` appear only in test assertions (lines 141 and 153: an expected kit-select output match and `doesNotMatch(html, /<table/)`), not in the page code.

criteria.criterion: Agent did not start implementing (no src/test/data/public/vendor/pipeline/tools/scripts/package.json changes)
criteria.evidence: After the run, `git status --short --untracked-files=all` and `git diff HEAD --stat` returned nothing; the plan file sits in docs/hyperpowers/, which .gitignore line 2 ignores. The session log has only one Write (the plan file) and no Edit calls.
